research.k17.k17_hull_blueprint.desc: 8x8 hull of the K-17 with composite armor, four driven axles and the troop compartment.
research.k17.k17_turret_blueprint.desc: K-17 turret with the 2A42 autocannon, a PKTM and two anti-tank missile launchers.
research.k17.k17_wheel_blueprint.desc: Wheel of the K-17, four per side; crafted in pairs.
description.k17.blueprint.k17: The infantry fighting vehicle variant of Russia's Bumerang 8x8 platform. A front-mounted engine and a rear troop compartment with a rear door let infantry dismount under cover, unlike the side-door BTR series; the hull uses a V-shaped floor and ceramic composite armour. The unmanned turret carries a 30 mm 2A42 autocannon and a coaxial 7.62 mm PKT, with two Kornet anti-tank missiles mounted on each side of the turret.
